evidence: app/src/pages/home.ts:132 — must add an isCurrent/teardown guard before merge

review_cost.rationale: One round of small, localized changes — nothing structural. All fixes are contained in the files that own the behavior.

findings.issue: The 150 ms search debounce fires applyFilters(true) even after the user has navigated away, so history.replaceState (home.ts:123) silently rewrites the new page's URL to /?q=…; reload/back then show the wrong page.
findings.suggestion: Guard the timer callback with ctx.isCurrent() (or clear the timer when the page is torn down): debounce = setTimeout(() => { if (ctx.isCurrent()) applyFilters(true); }, 150).

findings.issue: Promise.all(names.map(loadMember)) has no per-member error handling; a single species name in localStorage that the API 404s (stale data — the spec says data can change) turns the entire team page into 'Not found'.
findings.suggestion: Use Promise.allSettled and skip rejected members (optionally dropping them from storage), or catch NotFoundError per member.

findings.issue: result.ready errors are swallowed with catch(() => {}); a failed moves fetch leaves an empty Moves section stuck at aria-busy with no user feedback.
findings.suggestion: Log the error and render a small retry/failed notice in the section, or surface it like renderError.

findings.issue: The route table is duplicated between the server (ROUTES) and the client router (main.ts:26-34); adding a page requires editing both or the server starts returning 404 for valid URLs.
findings.suggestion: Define the route patterns once (e.g. a shared routes module imported by both, or have server.mjs read the client list) — or at minimum leave a comment in each file pointing at its twin.

findings.issue: history.scrollRestoration = 'manual' plus render(false) on popstate means Back navigation never restores the previous scroll position.
findings.suggestion: Either restore 'auto' or record/restore scroll positions keyed by history state.

findings.issue:
The role='status' count

is replaced wholesale on each filter update; a live region that is itself replaced generally does not announce.
findings.suggestion: Keep one persistent status element in the DOM and update its textContent instead of replacing the node.

findings.issue: Default-variety resolution (species.varieties.find(is_default) ?? [0] + pokemon fetch) is duplicated in pages/team.ts:16-19, and type-label maps are built three different ways (api.ts typeNames, pages/types.ts:26, pages/team.ts:24).
findings.suggestion: Extract a defaultPokemon(species) helper into api.ts and standardise on typeNames() for label lookups.

findings.issue: isOnTeam is exported but never used anywhere in the app.
findings.suggestion: Delete it, or use it in the Pokémon page's team button to make that code read declaratively.

findings.issue: setupMoves reads new URL(location.href) instead of the ctx.url passed to every page, inconsistent with the rest of the page and subtly racy in principle.
findings.suggestion: Use ctx.url (and pass the updated selection through ctx) rather than re-reading location.

findings.issue: Stray double blank line left after the feature diff's insertion (renderTeamAction() block).

summary: A genuinely well-structured vanilla TS/Vite SPA on current tooling, with careful concurrency handling, XSS-safe rendering and clean module boundaries; the team-builder feature fits the existing conventions and its coverage math is correct. Merge is blocked on two real bugs — a debounced search that corrupts the URL after fast navigation, and a team page that 404s entirely on one stale localStorage species — plus swallowed async errors and a duplicated client/server route table. All fixes are small and localized; I'd approve after one round.
